newsitem.title: USA: NationsBank announces new public finance hires.
newsitem.headline: NationsBank announces new public finance hires.

text.p: NationsBank Corp announced recent additions to its public finance management group Monday.

Jim Niederle, formerly with Texas Commerce Bank, is the most recent addition and is responsible for managing public finance efforts in Texas and expanding underwriting efforts in Oklahoma and New Mexico, NationsBank announced.
NationsBank also recently appointed William Darmstaedter managing director of its public finance west region and Peter Ramsey managing director of its public finance east region.

NationsBank has public finance offices in Charlotte, St. Louis, Dallas, Houston and Washington D.C. It is the fourth largest bank holding company in the country with more than $238 billion in assets as of March 31 and primary retail and commercial banking operations in 16 states and the District of Columbia.
